overview: The star of a team of teenage crime fighters falls for the alluring villainess she must bring to justice.

recs.blurb: Colonel Robert Sikes is on a mission to rid his city of crime. As a stealthy, one-man assault team, he will take on street gangs, mobsters, and politicians…
When a teenager, Chun-Li witnesses the kidnapping of her father by wealthy crime lord M. Bison. When she grows up, she goes into a quest for vengeance and…
Three teenagers' quest to qualify for the 2012 US Olympic table tennis team.
Two bank robbers fall in love with the girl they've kidnapped.
Three female employees of the Federal Reserve plot to steal money that is about to be destroyed.
After watching their respective partners die, a cop and a hitman form an alliance in order to bring down their common enemy.
Bi-polar mall security guard Ronnie Barnhardt is called into action to stop a flasher from turning shopper's paradise into his personal peep show. But when…
An elderly ex-serviceman and widower looks to avenge his best friend's murder by doling out his own form of justice.
A Chinese-American lesbian and her traditionalist mother are reluctant to go public with secret loves that clash against cultural expectations.
A man is out for justice after a group of corrupt police officers are unable to catch his wife's killer.
A former race car driver is abducted by a mysterious thief and forced to be the wheel-man for a crime that puts them both in the sights of the cops and the mob.
